channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: 2026 CMA Awards Jump to 7-Year Ratings High
item.description: Country music brought the house down! 🤠 The 2026 CMA Awards hit their biggest ratings in seven years—looks like Nashville had everyone tuned in. 🎶

item.title: BTS & ENHYPEN Are Big Winners on Night 1 of 2026 MAMA Awards
item.description: Night 1 belonged to BTS and ENHYPEN! 🏆✨ K-pop power was on full display at the 2026 MAMA Awards.

item.title: The Thrills Announce First Show In 19 Years
item.description: The Thrills are back onstage after 19 years! 🎸 A long-awaited return for fans of the indie-rock favorites.

item.title: Dolly Parton’s ‘Jolene’ Surpasses 1 Billion Spotify Streams: ‘Her Music Will Live on Forever’
item.description: One billion streams for “Jolene”! 💛 Dolly’s timeless classic keeps finding new hearts—and those harmonies aren’t going anywhere. 🎶

item.title: Billie Eilish to Headline BST Hyde Park for First Time: ‘She Inspires Fans, Challenges Our Industry to Be Better’
item.description: Billie Eilish is taking over BST Hyde Park for the first time! 🌟 A huge moment for an artist inspiring fans and pushing the industry forward. 🎶
